name: Clone row
description: The shot punches in, then copies of the speaker shoot out from behind them to both sides, smaller and darker the further out, like a row going back into the room. All copies talk in sync. Then they snap back with a blur.
when: When you talk about doing more at once, a team of agents, or 'ten of me': a moment that shows scale.
needs: the place of the speaker's head
how many copies on each side (1 to 4)
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
